messages.author: bianca.ricciserra.100225@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Welcome everyone to the Events Committee space. We have our hands full planning the regional workshops and setting up the webinar calendar for the coming year.

messages.author: isabela.duarte.100490@lakemail.example
messages.text: Thanks Margaux. I am pulling together the initial venue options for the East Coast workshop series now.

messages.author: bianca.ricciserra.100225@mailhaven.example
messages.text: The annual conference proposal is shaping up nicely. We need to make sure the competition judging categories reflect current artisanal trends.

messages.author: heidi.andersen.101803@homestead.example
messages.text: I can help review the food safety guidelines for the live demonstration tables if needed.

messages.author: isabela.duarte.100490@lakemail.example
messages.text: Registration numbers are looking strong for the spring sessions. Let us lock in the plenary speakers by next week.

messages.author: bianca.ricciserra.100225@mailhaven.example
messages.text: In light of current travel restrictions, we need to pause all in-person gatherings and pivot our schedule entirely to online courses and webinars.

messages.author: sven.dahl.102050@plumgatecreamery.example
messages.text: The virtual format for the summer modules is working surprisingly well. Attendance from European buyers has been steady.

messages.author: isabela.duarte.100490@lakemail.example
messages.text: We should start sketching out a virtual symposium for late spring since members are asking about online credentials and continuing education.

messages.author: bianca.ricciserra.100225@mailhaven.example
messages.text: It is a relief to plan an in-person conference again. Competition entries are already climbing faster than expected.

messages.author: eric.ryder.100705@dvorakfarmstead.example
messages.text: Capacity at the venue is going to be tight this year. We should keep an eye on registration caps.

messages.author: bianca.ricciserra.100225@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Let us get a head start on following up with speaker candidates for the autumn sessions so we do not run into scheduling conflicts.

messages.author: isabela.duarte.100490@lakemail.example
messages.text: The latest member feedback digest has been reviewed and filed with ICF staff.

messages.author: bianca.ricciserra.100225@mailhaven.example
messages.text: I have finished following up with the primary speaker candidates for the upcoming educational track.

messages.author: emilio.lozano.100862@aldermerecheeseschool.example
messages.text: I can assist with updating the committee charter page to reflect our revised focus areas.

messages.author: bianca.ricciserra.100225@mailhaven.example
messages.text: We have successfully collected all comments on the draft standard from the regional chapters.

messages.author: isabela.duarte.100490@lakemail.example
messages.text: The member feedback digest review is complete and the summary is posted on the portal.

messages.author: bianca.ricciserra.100225@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Now we need to finalize the venue logistics for the upcoming workshop before the August deadline.

messages.author: camila.caruso.101055@curdcraftacademy.example
messages.text: I am coordinating with the site host on the equipment setup for the raw-milk aging panel.
